sources.entry: Hi.Events - Event management and ticketing platform for conferences, concerts, and more. Offering customizable event pages and embeddable ticket widgets. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Hi.Events is an open-source event ticketing and management platform for selling tickets to conferences, concerts, festivals and similar events, self-hosted via Docker or available as a managed cloud service.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes ticket sales and event management for conferences, nightlife, concerts, workshops and festivals. Organizers can create one-off or recurring events with per-date prices and capacity, build event homepages and lineup/schedule pages, and sell paid, free, donation and tiered tickets with promo codes, waitlists and scheduled sale windows. Checkout includes Stripe payouts, taxes and fees, invoicing, refunds, and customisable embeds (ticket widgets, buttons, event lists) for an organizer's own site. Attendee features include check-in by phone camera or USB scanner, branded PDF tickets, attendee messaging, and sales/tax/promo reports. For organisations it lists single sign-on, two-factor authentication, team roles, multiple organizers, a REST API with API keys, webhooks, and CSV/XLSX exports. Box office and reserved seating are listed as Enterprise-licensed features.
use_cases: sell tickets for a conference or festival
run a club night or concert ticketing
embed ticket widgets on my own website
check in attendees at the door with a phone or scanner
how_to_run: Generate APP_KEY and JWT_SECRET into .env with openssl rand -base64 32
Open the configured URL and create an account; API keys are created under Settings → API keys
notable: Alternative to Eventbrite and Tickettailor that takes no per-ticket fee in the sense of the platform, with payouts to the organizer's own Stripe account
Customisable embeddable ticket widgets, buttons, event lists, lineups and schedules
Check-in by phone camera or USB scanner with shareable check-in lists and live counts
Docker all-in-one deployment, with a managed Hi.Events Cloud option
caveats: Reserved seating and the box office require a paid Enterprise Licence for production use
AGPL-3.0 licence includes an additional 'Powered by Hi.Events' attribution requirement; removing it requires a commercial licence
Upgrading from 1.x requires reading the release notes first
keywords: share event tickets with my team
